_metadata.standard: AAQS Standard Method of Measuring Building Work for Africa 2015

formulas.name: Plain Concrete Class 10 (1:4:8)
formulas.description: Plain concrete class 10, 20mm aggregate, mix 1:4:8 — used for mass fill, oversite. Quantities include 50% compaction allowance per Analysis schedule.

formulas.name: Plain Concrete Class 15 (1:3:6)
formulas.description: Plain concrete class 15, 20mm aggregate, mix 1:3:6 — used for blinding, strip foundations. Quantities include 50% compaction allowance per Analysis schedule.

formulas.name: Reinforced Concrete Grade 20 (1:2:4)
formulas.description: Vibrated reinforced concrete grade 20, 20mm aggregate, mix 1:2:4. Quantities include 50% compaction allowance per Analysis schedule.

formulas.name: Reinforced Concrete Grade 25 (1:1.5:3)
formulas.description: Vibrated reinforced concrete grade 25, 19mm aggregate, mix 1:1.5:3 — columns, beams, slabs. Quantities include 50% compaction allowance per Analysis schedule.

formulas.name: Reinforced Concrete Grade 30 (1:1:2)
formulas.description: Vibrated reinforced concrete grade 30, 19mm aggregate, mix 1:1:2 — high strength elements. Quantities include 50% compaction allowance per Analysis schedule.

formulas.name: 150mm Thick Floor Slab (C25)
formulas.description: 150mm thick reinforced concrete floor slab, grade 25, with BRC mesh reinforcement

formulas.name: BRC Welded Mesh Reinforcement (4.8×2.4m rolls)
formulas.description: BRC welded mesh reinforcement calculated per m² of slab area. Roll size 4.8m × 2.4m = 11.52m² per roll. From Analysis schedule.

formulas.name: Formwork to Suspended Slab Soffit
formulas.description: Formwork to soffits of suspended slabs, measured in m² per AAQS. Includes props, boards, release agent.

formulas.name: Formwork to Beams (Sides & Soffit)
formulas.description: Formwork to sides and soffits of beams, measured in m² per AAQS

formulas.name: Formwork to Columns
formulas.description: Formwork to sides of columns, measured in m² per AAQS

formulas.name: Formwork to Ring Beam (200mm high)
formulas.description: Formwork to sides of ring beam 200mm high, using Kirundu hardwood timber and plywood boards. From Analysis schedule.

formulas.name: Steel Reinforcement 8mm Bars
formulas.description: 8mm diameter mild steel reinforcement bars, cut, bent and fixed — measured in kg per AAQS. Weight factor: 0.400 kg/m (verified from BBS).

formulas.name: Steel Reinforcement 10mm Bars
formulas.description: 10mm diameter high yield steel reinforcement bars, cut, bent and fixed. Weight factor: 0.620 kg/m (verified from BBS).

components.materialName: 10mm High Yield Steel Bars Y10 (12m length, 0.620 kg/m)

formulas.name: Steel Reinforcement 12mm Bars
formulas.description: 12mm diameter high yield steel reinforcement bars (Grade 460B), cut, bent and fixed. Weight factor: 0.888 kg/m (verified from BBS).

components.materialName: 12mm High Yield Steel Bars Y12 (12m length, 0.888 kg/m)

formulas.name: Steel Reinforcement 16mm Bars
formulas.description: 16mm diameter high yield steel reinforcement bars (Grade 460B), cut, bent and fixed. Weight factor: 1.579 kg/m (verified from BBS).

components.materialName: 16mm High Yield Steel Bars Y16 (12m length, 1.579 kg/m)

formulas.name: Steel Reinforcement 20mm Bars
formulas.description: 20mm diameter high yield steel reinforcement bars (Grade 460B), cut, bent and fixed. Weight factor: 2.470 kg/m (verified from BBS).

components.materialName: 20mm High Yield Steel Bars Y20 (12m length, 2.470 kg/m)
